tool_log.query: Double Bottom ('W' Formation) pattern target stop loss rules

result.source: Major Reversal Price Patterns (Construction, Geometry & Math)

rules.text: Enter long when price closes above the neckline with volume ratio > 1.35x.
Stop-Loss is positioned 1.0x ATR below the second trough low.

result.content:
The Double Bottom ('W' Pattern) is one of the highest-performing bullish reversal formations:
        - Construction: Two distinct troughs at approximately the same support level (within 2-3% tolerance). The first trough forms on heavy panic selling volume. An intervening reaction rally produces a peak (the neckline). A secondary decline retests the support zone of the first trough on noticeably lighter volume, showing seller depletion.
        - Confluence: Often accompanied by bullish RSI or MACD divergence (RSI makes a higher low while price makes an equal or slightly lower low).
        - Confirmation: The pattern is confirmed only when price penetrates and closes above the intervening peak neckline on a surge of volume.
        - Measuring Target Formula: Measure the vertical height H from the lowest trough to the intervening peak neckline. Project H upward from the neckline breakout: Target Price = Neckline + H.
        - Protective Stop: Place stop-loss just below the lowest low of the two troughs or below the right trough low.

result.source: Major Reversal Price Patterns (Construction, Geometry & Math)

rules.text: Never short until price produces a confirmed close below the intervening neckline trough.
Stop-Loss is positioned above Peak 2 high.

result.content:
The Double Top ('M' Pattern) is a prominent reversal formation occurring at market cycle peaks:
        - Construction: Two prominent price peaks at approximately the same level (within 2-3% price difference). The first peak forms on heavy buying volume. A decline of 10-20% follows, creating an intervening trough (the neckline support). A second rally lifts price back to the resistance level of the first peak, but on significantly lower volume. Price fails to break through and rolls over.
        - Confirmation: The pattern is NOT confirmed when the second peak fails; it is confirmed ONLY when price decisively penetrates and closes below the intervening trough neckline.
        - Measuring Target Formula: Measure the vertical height H between the peaks and the neckline trough. Project H downward from the neckline breakout point: Target Price = Neckline - H.
        - Protective Stop: Place protective stop-loss slightly above the second peak or 1.2x ATR above the neckline.
